source_policy: Only the three complete intransitive aa+yam words printed in pinned Kasika 1.3.28 receive finite-position credit.

kashika.selected_context: अकर्मकादिति वर्तते। ... ताभ्यामकर्मकक्रियावचनाभ्यामाङ्पूर्वाभ्यामात्मनेपदं भवति। आयच्छते, आयच्छेते, आयच्छन्ते।

distinction: PG289's own-hand object obtains A from the later svanga-karmaka varttika, not this intransitive clause.
